questions.question: What type of correlation would you expect between hours of sleep and tiredness?
questions.correctAnswer: Negative correlation - more sleep means less tiredness.
questions.explanation: Answer: Negative correlation - more sleep means less tiredness.

questions.question: A line of best fit has equation y = 3x + 5. Predict y when x = 7.
A scatter graph shows test scores between 40% and 90%. Is predicting a score of 95% interpolation or extrapolation?
questions.correctAnswer: Extrapolation - 95% is outside the range of 40-90%.
questions.explanation: Answer: Extrapolation - 95% is outside the range of 40-90%.
